en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a stone and brick lookout tower with a rectangular base building featuring large windows. The tall tower has arched windows and a broad overhanging roof near the top. At the bottom of the image there is printed Hungarian text identifying the place. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address in Budapest, a green Hungarian postage stamp and a printed publisher's mark from Budapest.
